availability.D5_masks_during_POD0: apply existing 289 surgery-gated columns and descendants; extra21 VIS columns only preop quarantine, retain prefix-known postop D5 values; preserve cache NaNs
availability.D5_preop_VIS: conservative preop quarantine of dated postoperative VIS family including doses/IS/recording/last-value/age channels; not assertion every preop value is proven future information; same across all new arms
availability.date_metadata_to_model: only allowed asof transforms already in D5; no absolute calendar date or negative POD countdown
availability.mode: mask each source calendar row BEFORE any window/summary; never unmask history at current t

surgery_completion.POD0: unmask only if plausible_icu and icu_serial < actual_date+1

availability.two_hour_rule: plausible_icu and icu_serial+2/24 < actual_date+1; otherwise NaN at all dates

deny_features.metadata_use: keys/eligibility/label/evaluation/gating only through separated APIs, never implicit feature or padding input

outputs: OLS slope per doubling of train case stays
learning_curve.sampling: separate case/control hashed stay permutations, nested floor(f*n) prefixes, shared over models
learning_curve.slope: OLS within-repeat AUROC on log2(training case stay n) over four fractions, then mean over three repeats; shared test stay bootstrap with fixed predictions; descriptive conditional interval

GAIN10.columns: fit-pool-specific; persisted privately, aggregate selection frequencies only in report

GAIN100.columns: fit-pool-specific; persisted privately, aggregate selection frequencies only in report

GAIN20.columns: fit-pool-specific; persisted privately, aggregate selection frequencies only in report

GAIN29.columns: fit-pool-specific; persisted privately, aggregate selection frequencies only in report

GAIN5.columns: fit-pool-specific; persisted privately, aggregate selection frequencies only in report

GAIN50.columns: fit-pool-specific; persisted privately, aggregate selection frequencies only in report

GSAFE.supervised_encoding: current fit pool crossfit only; ban risk codes 320/330; all availability gates retained

PI10.role: independent fixed interpretation group only; no source-bank learner

A-formal.interpretation: development estimate; no untouched holdout; no cross-frame AUC subtraction
A-formal.label: y3
A-formal.risk_set: unchanged clean-linked formal a/b/none; pre-first-NEC, pre-discharge; original POD bound

PI72-CLEAN.interpretation: local cleaned-table retrospective sampling contract; manuscript final scoring composition unresolved
PI72-CLEAN.label: outcome_3d
PI72-CLEAN.phase_interpretation: calendar POD>=0, not proven surgery/ICU completed at all POD0 cutoffs
PI72-CLEAN.prediction_cutoff: end of calendar day t; timestamp < t+1

handoff.scope: Final LightGBM paths and independent exploratory methods; reduced export specification

inner_validation.choice: mean of 3 validation AUROCs; tie-within-0.002 deterministic simplification
inner_validation.implementation: sort exact stay keys; sklearn StratifiedKFold(n_splits=3,shuffle=True,random_state=derived_seed) on one row per stay; expand all dates
inner_validation.person_level_linkage: not verified; IndexSurgHosp header has hospitalization identity only; cluster unit is hospitalization
inner_validation.refit: rerank/reencode/refit entire outer training pool only after choices fixed
inner_validation.stratify: stay max(label) within current fit pool

SHAP.R3: group all seven same-source summaries; also show observation/missingness contribution separately
SHAP.primary_weighting: equal repeats; equal rows inside repeat
SHAP.sensitivity_weighting: equal stays inside repeat; equal repeats
SHAP.unselected_feature: zero program attribution, marked not included, not biological null

T3c.paired_stay_sensitivity: within same held-out model, stays observed in adjacent POD bins: later-minus-earlier within-stay mean abs grouped SHAP, support n and stay bootstrap; conditional on observation in both bins; never model eligibility filter
T3c.rank_interval: bootstrap rank percentiles within model and stratum only; unselected=0 contribution with selection flag; undefined small strata=null

interpretation.gain: normalize within each model; training split-use description only

permutation.donor_algorithm: within each eligible stratum, seeded shuffle distinct stay keys then cyclic shift by RNG integer in [1,n-1]; no self donors; swap whole selected block
permutation.feature_level_budget: per model: top20 source concepts by primary held-out mean(sum abs SHAP), union present PI10 and ACTION16; plus all listed semantic groups; lag-block groups only for multi-day tree
permutation.interpretation: fixed-model reliance under perturbation; correlated substitutes and possible off-manifold lag blocks; not causal
permutation.resampling_unit: hospitalization, never window or permutation iteration
semantic_families: arterial support all site states+durations+aggregate line counts
permutation.small_group: unchanged; report coverage, do not interpret zero as no importance
permutation.structural_gate_protection: donor and recipient share surgery and two-hour availability bit patterns for every relevant historical slot; native missingness may be permuted
permutation.unit: entire predictor/history block at a target calendar day, donor from distinct hospitalization

LGB.early_stop_metric: frame-specific primary metric on inner validation only
LGB.outer_rounds: integer median of 3 inner best_iteration counts

PI_simultaneous_family.reference: matched selected recipe+learner w1, refitted with that fit-pool selection

metrics.PI_true_preop_auc: null because no positive preop rows

bootstrap.simultaneous: q95(max contrast abs(delta_boot-delta_hat)); delta_hat +/- q; arbitrary declared family length

metrics.point_estimate: equal mean of within-repeat AUROCs and paired deltas; Task A pools 5 outer OOF folds within repeat first

promotion_rule.A_claim: separate Task A total AUROC family; no cross-frame differences
promotion_rule.PI_champion_candidate: pass both local and GSAFE contrast

seeds.alias_seed: canonical arm seed; no new seed

R1.features: k*w values + w row-observed indicators + observed-day count

windows.bounds: same stay dates [t-w+1,t]; calendar slots oldest-to-current internally
windows.lag_availability: historical day gate, never current-day unmask
windows.padding_features: row observed indicators and prefix window observed day count only; never total stay length or last date
windows.source_PI_history: labelled retained CORE rows only; no sentinel/unlabelled/future/extra case days
windows.w1: R1/R3 same T8 single-day canonical arm; no independent refit; constant structural indicators omitted
